title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 5.77 (versions follow prime numbers; 577 after 571): she does not say again what she said, and her song's dice are her rain. A memory already in the last of their talk is not said again while she has another: first the memories she has not said, the nearest first; when she has said them all, her school's song; with no rule in it, her luck among her memories. The song drew its lots from the same seed every time; now her body leaves her rain as it is at that moment (its 1,976 hexadecimal digits, bytes of her creatures and of her thoughts) and the song takes its seed from it: no number is made up. Her imagination works again in what she answers, by her wish. Seen in a hidden copy: the same phrase three times, three different answers, in 1 to 5 seconds. What the song composes is still weak with so few examples. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v5.57: Luma purificada. Prototipo de investigación.
